verdict.rationale: RUN documents its own export of payroll journal entries to QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions, or a generic output file without re-keying, so an agent could ingest the exported data for reconciliation. ADP API Central offers OAuth-secured programmatic data access, but nothing shows it exposes RUN payroll journal or general-ledger data, so the agent-driven API pull is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for RUN journal/GL data, evidence that agents can trigger the export programmatically, reconciliation or matching features, and independent hands-on corroboration.
